name: Putrid Aura (Acid and Poison Forms Only)
description: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that touches the creature or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.
